description: Retrieves full details for an existing Stripe coupon using its unique ID. Use when you need to check coupon validity, discount details, or redemption limits.

inputSchema.description: Specifies the coupon ID to retrieve.

coupon_id.description: Unique identifier for the coupon to retrieve.
coupon_id.title: Coupon Id

inputSchema.title: GetCouponRequest

name: get_coupon

AppliesTo.description: Details about which products the coupon applies to.

products.description: List of product IDs this coupon applies to.
products.title: Products

AppliesTo.title: AppliesTo

amount_off.description: Discount amount for the specified currency in smallest currency unit.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

GetCouponResponse.description: Contains detailed information of the retrieved coupon.

amount_off.description: Fixed discount amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents). Null if percentage-based discount.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

applies_to.description: Product restrictions containing list of product IDs this coupon applies to.
applies_to.title: Applies To

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the coupon was created.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (lowercase) for amount_off. Required if amount_off is set.
currency.title: Currency

currency_options.description: Per-currency discount amounts with nested amount_off values.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

duration_in_months.description: Number of months the coupon applies for repeating duration. Null for non-repeating.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Whether the coupon exists in live mode (true) or testmode (false).
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed across all customers. Null means unlimited.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'coupon'.
object.title: Object

percent_off.description: Percentage discount (e.g., 25.5 means 25.5% off). Null if fixed amount discount.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Unix timestamp after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed. Null if no expiration.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Whether the coupon can still be redeemed (taking into account redeem_by and max_redemptions).
valid.title: Valid

GetCouponResponse.title: GetCouponResponse
